'''Tindalo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He made his living as a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] on board [[Carrick Station]].

==Behind the scenes==
Tindalo first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] planetary commendation vendor on board Carrick Station. He was later relabeled as the Level 29 Equipment Vendor, though he was later removed along with the rest of the planetary Equipment Vendors in Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]].
